route_classes.name: single_root_namespace
route_classes.authorization: before root state or result observables

route_classes.name: historical_aliases
route_classes.selector: mutually exclusive root_hash, snapshot, or version alias

route_classes.name: content_staging
route_classes.authorization: staging authority grants no namespace reachability

route_classes.name: hash_retrieval
route_classes.selector: selected-root reachability for FileRecord; admin diagnostic authority for raw internal entities
route_classes.authorization: before type, existence, count, timing, or bytes

route_classes.name: operational_auth_system
route_classes.selector: none unless the typed operation names source roots

route_classes.name: mutation
route_classes.selector: generic root_hash rejected; route-specific historical source may create current authority
route_classes.authorization: before dependency reads and mutation admission
route_classes.response_root: new current root when namespace changes

configuration_rules.environment_mapping: AEORDB_ plus uppercased dotted path with dots replaced by underscores
configuration_rules.cli_mapping: -- plus dotted path with dots replaced by hyphens and underscores replaced by hyphens

dynamic_records.name: system_control
dynamic_records.discoverability: protected control subtree plus selected A/B or immutable identity

dynamic_records.name: index_artifact
dynamic_records.discoverability: IndexArtifact EntryType plus owning manifests and active-generation controls

dynamic_records.name: gc_artifact
dynamic_records.discoverability: GcArtifact EntryType plus selected GC controls

dynamic_records.name: external_mark_workspace
dynamic_records.discoverability: workspace header binds database, physical instance, run, layout, and root snapshot

dynamic_records.name: emergency_spill
dynamic_records.discoverability: all configured and OS fallback roots plus spill catalog and embedded database identity

dynamic_records.name: migration_capture
dynamic_records.discoverability: selected migration lease/progress control plus external capture manifest

dynamic_records.name: task_checkpoint
dynamic_records.discoverability: task ID and selected checkpoint control or task-owned external manifest

dynamic_records.name: retirement_acceleration_journal
dynamic_records.discoverability: selected checkpoint and monotonic write-sequence interval

hard_transitions.name: database_header_ab
hard_transitions.selector: highest valid sequence; equal divergent sequence is corruption
hard_transitions.crash_after: new valid slot is selected and read back

hard_transitions.name: system_control_ab
hard_transitions.selector: highest valid sequence with repeated identity
hard_transitions.crash_after: new control selected only after dependency barrier

hard_transitions.name: namespace_root_publication
hard_transitions.crash_after: new closed root and dependencies are authoritative

hard_transitions.name: index_active_generation
hard_transitions.crash_after: new generation used only with valid coverage

hard_transitions.name: gc_mark_publication
hard_transitions.crash_before: no quarantine eligibility from incomplete mark
hard_transitions.crash_after: complete mark becomes one eligibility observation

hard_transitions.name: root_lifecycle_retirement
hard_transitions.crash_after: retired root returns deterministic gone before physical reclaim

hard_transitions.name: sweep_void_publication
hard_transitions.selector: selected sweep receipt then selected Void catalog
hard_transitions.crash_before: space leaks and is not allocatable
hard_transitions.crash_after: only receipt-backed ranges become allocator authority

hard_transitions.name: void_claim_settlement
hard_transitions.selector: selected Void catalog minus durable immutable claims
hard_transitions.crash_after: settled claim has exactly one owner or returns to catalog

hard_transitions.name: durability_latch
hard_transitions.crash_before: ambiguous write is recovered or startup fails closed
hard_transitions.crash_after: database opens read-only until explicit repair clears latch

hard_transitions.name: side_by_side_cutover
hard_transitions.selector: external cutover A/B journal plus physical database identity
hard_transitions.crash_after: v4 becomes authority only after verified durable replace

hard_transitions.name: writer_fence_epoch
hard_transitions.crash_before: prior process cannot publish under a new epoch
hard_transitions.crash_after: all new publication guards recheck the selected epoch

hard_transitions.name: task_checkpoint_publication
hard_transitions.crash_after: resume only after identity and continuity validation

cleanup_result_classes.name: required_authority
cleanup_result_classes.behavior: propagate failure and do not report success

cleanup_result_classes.name: required_durability
cleanup_result_classes.behavior: propagate failure and apply serious-failure latch policy

cleanup_result_classes.name: optional_temporary
cleanup_result_classes.behavior: preserve primary result, warn, and record cleanup debt

cleanup_result_classes.name: optional_telemetry
cleanup_result_classes.behavior: preserve primary result, warn, and increment visible telemetry debt
